text: F. .AL DIAGNOSIS. 1. RIGHT LOWER LOBE, LUNG (RESECTION) : MODERATELY DIFFERENTIATED. SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA (4.5 CM) - THE TUMOR EXTENDS SUBPLEURALLY BUT. DOES NOT INVADE THROUGH THE VISCERAL PLEURA. THE VASCULAR AND. BRONCHIAL SURGICAL MARGINS ARE NEGATIVE FOR TUMOR. THREE (3). LYMPH NODES, NEGATIVE FOR TUMOR. THE PATHOLOGIC STAGE IS T2NOMX. NOTE: Although we favor that this tumor represents a primary lung. carcinoma, we cannot exclude the possibility of a lung metastasis on. morphologic grounds. 2. STATION 7 LYMPH NODE (EXCISION) : ONE (1) LYMPH NODE AND. ASSOCIATED FIBROADIPOSE TISSUE, NEGATIVE FOR TUMOR. 3. R4 LYMPH NODE (EXCISION) : ONE (1) LYMPH NODE AND ASSOCIATED.
